_arm_note: Hierarchical PPO with hybrid action heads (Categorical primitive + Gaussian Dx/Dy/Dtheta). Replaces the failed TD3 setup. Path-2 architecture: single network used across all stages; stage 1 only enables param-free primitives so the Gaussian head sits idle but stays trainable, then stage 2+ unlocks primitives that read its outputs. See TRAINING.md and /Users/Adnan/.claude/plans/sprightly-singing-kite.md for the full rationale.

stage1_015_warm.description: DISABLED (timesteps=0). Stage 1 warmup was a TD3 holdover — its purpose was to bake in kick mechanics on an easy spawn distribution. PPO with hybrid action heads doesn't need that warm-start: the value function picks up the +150 goal reward just as fast at stage 1.090 alongside the more interesting kick-vs-turn discrete decision. Re-enable only if stage 1.090 stalls early and we want a 5k-step value-function pre-fill (in which case: set timesteps to ~5000 and keep this disabled_actions list).

stage1_090_mid.description: RUNG 1 — DONE (300k complete; 100% last-100 eps, bad_aim 90%→0.0%; checkpoint stage1_090_mid_complete.pt is the lineage root, loaded via top-level load_model for the overnight chain). EXPANDABLE-BACKBONE STAGE 1 — RUNG 1 (aim bootstrap), retrained from scratch on the new attention network (flat-MLP checkpoints can't load into it). ball_y narrowed to ±6 so the goal window is wide enough to learn aim against the turn-noise floor (LOG_STD_MIN=-3.0). Adds `turn` (Gaussian Dtheta active via param_active_mask); kick enabled; approach_ball disabled (robot spawns within kickable_dist so approach is a no-op); dribbles disabled. This is the lineage root: rungs 2-5 (stage1_180_full/_y10/_y15/stage1_9) warm-start from this via top-level load_model, no rebuild. Flat-MLP §16 hit 94% goal / bad_aim 86%→4% from scratch; target the same bar. Budget 300k. New-lineage checkpoint: models/ppo_jal_expandable/stage1_090_mid_complete.pt.

Result: 89.0% overall goal rate, 87.7% deterministic inference, bad_aim 0.0%. Instant transfer from stage1_180_y10. stage1_9.description: RUNG 5 — FINAL Stage-1 task (overnight chain, runs last, on the NEW expandable backbone; warm-starts IN-MEMORY from rung 4. New checkpoint: models/ppo_jal_expandable/stage1_9_complete.pt). HOME-SPOT APPROACH → TURN → KICK: final Stage 1 task. Robot starts at its fixed home pose (-10, 0) facing a random heading; ball spawns at full distribution (x∈[5,30], y∈[-15,15]). Must approach 15–43 units (approach_ball enabled for the first time), turn to aim, then kick. goto and dribbles stay disabled — Gaussian Dx/Dy head still idle, only Dtheta active. approach_weight=1.0 (not 1.8): worst-case park EV = 1.0×43−10 = 33 << goal 70; at 1.8 it would be 67≈goal (unsafe local optimum). Acceptance: goal ≥ 50% over final 1000 eps; no primitive > 90% in any 100-ep window. Warm-start: models/ppo_jal_curriculum/stage1_180_y15_complete.pt. Budget: 300,000 steps — first stage with genuine approach learning, not an instant transfer.

stage2_goalie.description: STAGE 2 STUB — REWARD SIDE DONE, TRAINER WIRING NEEDED (set timesteps > 0 to enable). 1v1 vs scripted goalie (ai_interface/goalie.py): approach + turn + kick + dribble, ball spawns in the attacking third near the penalty arc. Reward is fully wired in reward.py / JAL_env.py: (1) use_goalie_aim_gate switches the kick bonus AND the dense ball_speed / goal_progress gates from center-mouth aim to GOALIE-GAP quality (0 = shot at keeper's y, 1 = max in-mouth separation) — breaks the stage-1 center-shot habit; goalie_gap_blend_center=0.3 eases transfer from the stage-1 checkpoint, fade toward 0.0 once goal rate recovers. (2) Dribble session rules enforced in JAL_env._action_to_commands: 1.0 m max radius from the start_dribble anchor (exhaustion forces a drop), re-dribble requires robot-ball separation > kickable_dist + 0.2; dribble bonus pays only inside the valid envelope while moving laterally away from the keeper's y. (3) stop_dribble_release_bonus pays releasing late in a session (>= 70% of radius) to teach stop -> re-approach -> kick. TRAINER WORK REMAINING: spawn the opponent goalie robot and drive it with goalie.py each cycle (aux scripted policy in the rollout loop — JAL_env only reads its pose from game_state via _opponent_goalie_pose, nearest opponent to GOAL_R), warm-start from models/ppo_jal_expandable/stage1_9_complete.pt, and consider adding goalie (x,y) to a context slot (+context_active_mask) as a follow-up if corner placement plateaus — the obs currently has no goalie dims, so placement must be inferred from ball y correlation. Weights below mirror stage-1 scale (goal 70): tune kick_into_keeper_penalty / opponent_near_ball_penalty against goal rate, gap_quality logs (JAL_env 'Kick fired' lines), and invalid start_dribble rate.
